author: Cleo Abram
description:
Every 2 to 7 years meteorologists start talking about an “El Niño year.” We get the idea that this is going to create some weird weather, but what exactly drives this force? The answer lies in the Pacific ocean and some strange weather patterns that we still don’t fully understand. For more, subscribe!

#Science #meteorology #weather #ElNino
title: The Weather System Is About To Break
